validation.name: Remaining limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or human screen-reader testing. Live browser verification covers two real database-backed public product pages and their hydration/interactions, not every product, authenticated state or purchase flow. All mutation requests blocked; no orders, payments, customer-account or inventory changes. Performance preserved by source identity and UI checks, without a new performance benchmark. New Change History reports are saved locally; the exact approved deployment source was not changed to bundle them.
